program: Program 2 — Test engineering and release gate

layers.name: Unit
layers.scope: Services, models, calculations, schedulers, permissions and business rules.
layers.runner: pytest backend/tests/test_memory.py test_flashcards.py test_learning_science.py test_memory_properties.py test_learning_properties.py test_security_contract.py
layers.gate: All green. Property tests run 150-200 generated cases each; a failure prints the minimal counterexample.

layers.name: Integration
layers.scope: API endpoints, persistence, transactions, migrations and external-provider failure.
layers.gate: All green on SQLite and on PostgreSQL. The PostgreSQL half skips only when no server is reachable, and a skip is reported as a skip, never as a pass.

layers.name: Native UI
layers.scope: Real SwiftUI interactions: navigation, forms, dialogs, accessibility, error states.
layers.gate: All ten journeys exercised through AXUIElement presses and typing against the running app, with a screenshot per journey.

layers.name: End-to-end system
layers.scope: Complete journeys across app, backend, database, offline behaviour and distribution.
layers.gate: Journey verdicts are corroborated by the isolated database the launcher inspects after the app exits (attempts, messages, saved preferences), so a green UI cannot stand alone.

journeys.title: First launch, registration and onboarding
journeys.requirement: A stranger can install the app, create an account, complete first-run setup and reach a personalised plan.
journeys.native: OnboardingView / CourseSetup.swift: auth.name, auth.email, auth.password, auth.age, auth.terms, auth.register; setup.course.*, setup.goal, setup.pace.*, setup.finish.
journeys.backend: POST /api/v1/auth/register; GET /api/v1/courses; POST /api/v1/setup or profile update; plan compiled by app/planner.py.
journeys.data: users (id, email, password_hash, course_id, goal, daily_minutes, age_confirmed_at, terms_accepted_at), tokens, refresh_tokens.
journeys.tests: tests/test_api.py (registration, compliance gate); tests/test_accounts.py; this journey.
journeys.acceptance: The auth form is replaced by the shell, the setup sheet is gone, YOUR PLAN is visible, and the launcher finds exactly one user row with the registered email.

journeys.title: Selecting a course and starting a lesson
journeys.requirement: A learner can open a lesson for the enrolled course and see that course's content.
journeys.native: Core.swift Page.studio; Studio.swift concept header and lesson.read / lesson.deck / lesson.lecture actions.
journeys.acceptance: The studio opens on the enrolled course, at least one lesson action is present and enabled, and the lesson text belongs to that course rather than the mathematics fallback.

journeys.title: Completing a practice question and receiving grading feedback
journeys.requirement: A submitted answer is graded, explained, and written down as an attempt.
journeys.native: Studio.swift practice action; QuestionView.swift question.option.*, question.reasoning, question.submit, question.next, question.finish.
journeys.data: attempts (question_id, concept_id, correct, mode, payload), learning_states (mastery, stability, difficulty, due_at).
journeys.acceptance: Feedback names the correct answer or explains the gap, Next question is offered, and the isolated database contains one more attempt than before the journey.

journeys.title: Completing a review and receiving the next scheduled review
journeys.requirement: A completed review schedules the next one; the queue is not a dead end.
journeys.native: TodayKnowledge.swift ReviewView: review.start, question.*; Flashcards.swift flashcards.reveal and flashcards.grade.*.
journeys.data: learning_states, flashcards (stability, difficulty, due_at, reps, lapses).
journeys.acceptance: After a graded review the queue is re-read from the backend and the item's next due date moves forward. An empty queue is recorded as blocked with its reason, never as a pass.

journeys.title: Leaving and reopening an autosaved project
journeys.requirement: Draft work survives navigating away, with no explicit save.
journeys.native: ProjectsInsightsSettings.swift project.text, project.reflection; navigation through nav.projects / nav.today.
journeys.acceptance: Text typed into the real editor is still in the field after navigating to Today and back.

journeys.title: Creating a course and accessing it again
journeys.requirement: A learner can author a course in the app and reopen it later.
journeys.native: LuminfestApp.swift shell header 'Create a course' (course.create) opens CourseAuthoringSheet: title/subject/level/notes, preview, create, enrol, close; NativeQA.swift J6 drives every control through AXUIElement.
journeys.data: created_courses, course units and lessons (JSON), users.course_id.
journeys.tests: backend/tests/test_authoring.py; backend/tests/test_course_creation.py; native/Sources/LearningHarness/NativeQA.swift journey J6 (first-person AX driver).
journeys.acceptance: Preview names extracted concepts and saves nothing; create returns a course id owned by the account but not yet active; enrol confirms and reloads the plan; the sidebar is reachable after the sheet closes. A missing entry point or any undrivable step is reported as gap/blocked, never as pass.

journeys.title: Using the tutor offline and handling provider failure
journeys.requirement: A missing or failing model still produces a grounded answer, never an empty bubble.
journeys.native: Studio.swift teacher.message, teacher.send, tutor.error; MarkdownText rendering of the reply.
journeys.backend: POST /api/v1/agent/chat; app/tutor.py offline_answer() fallback on provider failure; provider label.
journeys.acceptance: New tutor text appears, it is labelled as curriculum-grounded rather than a live model, and no raw provider exception is shown.

journeys.title: Using read-aloud and handling unavailable voice services
journeys.requirement: Read-aloud speaks, or refuses with a named reason; it never silently does nothing.
journeys.native: Studio.swift lesson.read, tutor.speak; Voice.swift speech client; Stop reading state.
journeys.data: No learner data is written; a refusal returns a named reason.
journeys.acceptance: Pressing read-aloud changes visible state, and with no voice service the refusal is named rather than silent.

journeys.title: Viewing Insights and distinguishing learning from engagement
journeys.requirement: Insights separates measured outcomes from activity and says which is which.
journeys.native: ProjectsInsightsSettings.swift insights charts; SUBMITTED ANSWERS ONLY caption; engagement section.
journeys.acceptance: The measured chart is captioned as submissions only, the no-practice empty state is gone after J3, and engagement is labelled separately from mastery.

journeys.title: Changing consent, exporting data and deleting an account
journeys.requirement: Consent is changeable, export is reachable, and deletion is deliberate and gated.
journeys.native: ProjectsInsightsSettings.swift settings.telemetry, settings.save, settings.export, settings.delete; deletion sheet phrase field and Delete permanently.
journeys.backend: PATCH /api/v1/me; GET /api/v1/export; DELETE /api/v1/me with a typed confirmation phrase; app/account_erasure.py.
journeys.data: users.telemetry_consent, training_consent_ledger, erasure ledger outside the database.
journeys.acceptance: The consent change is confirmed, export is offered and enabled, and the destructive action stays disabled until DELETE MY ACCOUNT is typed. Cancelling leaves the account signed in.
